name: North Node Changelog
description: Defines the North Node ontology version history and future work.

changes: Established `develop` as the North Node canonical primary verb.
Defined the North Node as developmental direction rather than destiny.
Required explicit South Node reference in all directional resolution.
Completed identity, grammar, language, semantics, psychology, development, expression, query, reasoning, and test architecture.
Added fatalism, moral-ranking, and South-Node-abandonment regression protections.

provenance.sourcePolicy: Developmental-direction vocabulary only. No destiny, fate, moral ranking, or guaranteed outcome claims are permitted.
